digest.component_or_area: Rebar Pydantic Agent run boundary — usage, failure, and artifact contracts
propositions: Aggregate whole-run usage from all retry attempts is projected once through _extract_usage, agent_call, gates, and durable JSONL row without per-attempt emission or rejection subtraction.

On validation-failure exhaustion, walk the __cause__ chain from terminating UnexpectedModelBehavior to recover and re-raise the IDENTICAL original StructuredOutputError object; on output-size/concision exhaustion where no Rebar object exists on the chain, construct a fresh UnretryableOutputError as the defined fallback.
Complete final provider response is captured only at terminal failure through opt-in artifact policy; retry-wire message omission never mutates stored artifacts.
Failure diagnostics retain consumed requests, tool calls, and provider tokens without fabricating usage for calls that reported none.
Successful multi-attempt runs report aggregate counters (requests and output_tokens summed across all attempts) in memory, telemetry, and exactly one durable JSONL row.
Existing pricing, historical rows, and schema remain byte-compatible after higher counters from successful retry; no new core usage fields or competing request-budget aliases introduced.
